eps.ov: After Meryl and Milly’s search for the legendary Vash the Stampede leads them to an encounter with a dangerous group of bounty hunters, an unlikely hero arrives to save them.
eps.oa: يقود بحث «ميريل» و«ميلي» عن «فاش ذا ستامبيد» الأسطوري إلى مواجهة مع جماعة خطرة من صائدي الجوائز، فيصل بطل لم يكن في الحسبان لإنقاذهما.

eps.ov: Meryl and Milly seek shelter in the mansion of Cliff Schezar, a wealthy man who has hired Vash as a bodyguard! Have the girls finally found the infamous gunslinger? Or is Cliff hiding something?
eps.oa: تحتمي «ميريل» و«ميلي» في قصر «كليف شيزار»، الرجل الثري الذي استأجر «فاش» حارساً شخصياً! فهل وجدت الفتاتان أخيراً المسلح سيئ الصيت؟ أم أن كليف يخفي شيئاً؟

eps.ov: Vash is looking for a renowned gunsmith named Frank Marlon. He finds him - but the legendary craftsman is a drunken mess! Making things worse, a group of bandits has learned that there’s no sheriff in town!
eps.oa: يبحث «فاش» عن صانع أسلحة ذائع الصيت يُدعى «فرانك مارلون». فيجده، لكن الصانع الأسطوري صار حطام رجل فاقداً صوابه! ومما يزيد الطين بلة أن عصابة من قطاع الطرق عرفت أن البلدة بلا مأمور!

eps.ov: Vash finds himself in the middle of a hostage crisis when outlaws take the mayor’s daughter - and Meryl and Milly - captive. He quickly discovers that these bad guys might not actually be the bad guys
eps.oa: يجد «فاش» نفسه وسط أزمة رهائن حين يأسر خارجون عن القانون ابنة العمدة، ومعها «ميريل» و«ميلي». وسرعان ما يكتشف أن هؤلاء الأشرار قد لا يكونون الأشرار حقاً.

eps.ov: With an entire town after the bounty on his head, Vash must contend with the dangerously destructive Nebraska Brothers - while saving the very same villagers who are bent on bringing him in!
eps.oa: بلدة كاملة تسعى وراء الجائزة المرصودة لرأس «فاش»، فعليه أن يواجه «الأخوين نبراسكا» المدمرين الخطرين، بينما ينقذ القرويين أنفسهم الذين عزموا على تسليمه!

eps.ov: Vash is completely smitten with Elizabeth, a stunning beauty who has arrived in town to repair the local plant. Hopefully Vash isn’t too distracted by her charms - because the enemy is very close indeed.
eps.oa: يُفتن «فاش» تماماً بـ«إليزابيث»، الحسناء الفاتنة التي جاءت إلى البلدة لإصلاح المحطة المحلية. وليته لا ينشغل بسحرها كثيراً، فالعدو قريب جداً.

eps.ov: Aboard a sand steamer, Vash meets a kid named Kaite - who might be up to no good - and finds himself going up against the notorious Bad Lad Gang.
eps.oa: على متن سفينة رملية بخارية يلتقي «فاش» صبياً يُدعى «كايتي» قد يكون ينوي شراً، فيجد نفسه في مواجهة «عصابة باد لاد» سيئة السمعة.

eps.t: And Between the Wasteland and Sky
eps.ov: The Bad Lads and their ruthless leader, B.D. Neon, have control of the steamer! With the captain steering the vessel toward disaster, Vash must act quick to save the people on board.
eps.oa: استولى أفراد «باد لاد» وزعيمهم القاسي «بي دي نيون» على السفينة! والقبطان يوجهها نحو الكارثة، فعلى «فاش» أن يتحرك سريعاً لينقذ من على متنها.

eps.ov: During a bus trip to May City, Vash, Meryl, and Milly encounter a priest named Nicholas D. Wolfwood. Before too long, the travelers finds their journey interrupted by a horde of attacking robotic spiders!
eps.oa: في رحلة بالحافلة إلى «ماي سيتي» يصادف «فاش» و«ميريل» و«ميلي» راهباً يُدعى «نيكولاس د. وولفوود». وسرعان ما تنقطع رحلة المسافرين بهجوم حشد من العناكب الآلية!

eps.ov: Vash and Wolfwood enter a quick-draw competition in May City. If one of them wins, the prize money will go to a poor local family. Unfortunately, they’re both in line of fire - the contest is rigged!
eps.oa: يشارك «فاش» و«وولفوود» في مسابقة للسحب السريع في «ماي سيتي»، فإن فاز أحدهما ذهبت الجائزة إلى أسرة فقيرة من أهل المدينة. لكنهما كليهما في مرمى النيران للأسف، فالمسابقة مغشوشة!

eps.ov: Things get complicated when the gang gets tangled up in the drama surrounding a runaway dancing girl and the son of a caravan owner.
eps.oa: تتعقد الأمور حين تتورط الجماعة في القصة المحيطة براقصة هاربة وابن صاحب قافلة.

eps.ov: Vash is thrown in jail after being accused of killing a local shoemaker. Even if he gets out of his cell, there’s going to be trouble -Monev the Gale is gunning for him after being hired by Legato!
eps.oa: يُلقى «فاش» في السجن بعد أن يُتهم بقتل إسكافي محلي. وحتى إن خرج من زنزانته فالمتاعب تنتظره، فـ«مونيف العاصفة» يتربص به بعد أن استأجره «ليغاتو»!

eps.ov: Meryl files a report the Bernadelli Insurance Company, recounting the many exploits, misadventures, and lunatic moments of Vash the Stampede.

An elderly couple asks Millie and Meryl to help them protect a piece of valuable property from their rivals. With hired killers nearby, and Vash nowhere to be found, Meryl and Millie might be in over their heads.

The Roderick gang’s battle with Legato is violently interrupted by the fierce Gung-Ho Guns. Just as Vash begins to investigate the incident, he meets Dominique the Cyclops, a lethal beauty with an amazing power.
Vash faces off with two of the Gung-Ho Guns: E.G. Mine and Rai-Dei the Blade. When the action heats up, Vash the Stampede is forced to unleash a new and devastating attack.
A flashback offers a glimpse into the distant past of Vash the Stampede, his brother, Millions Knives, and the enigmatic Rem Saverem.
Wolfwood meets Lina, a girl who’s having trouble with a guy who claims to be Vash the Stampede. When she’s abducted, Wolfwood must team up with an odd fellow name Erics to save her.
With reports of new Vash sightings, Meryl returns to the work of tracking him down. Meanwhile, Vash and Wolfwood make their way to a town where a family feud has escalated into a hostage situation.
During a massive typhoon, Vash the Stampede catches a ride through the sky on the wild winds - and lands on a ship full of familiar faces!
Vash and Wolfwood are in danger on the Project Seeds ship. The Puppetmaster’s goons - members of the Gung-Ho Guns - are on a killing spree and the entire ship could be destroyed.
Vash and the gang meet a group of orphans whose parents vanished after falling victim to a strange trance. Is it Legato’s doing? Or is there a secret villain hidden among the children?
Wolfwood decides it’s time for one last duel with Vash, but the gunslingers’ face-off is interrupted. Vash takes off after Caine the Longshot, while Wolfwood faces Chapel the Evergreen.
After Vash faces Midvalley the Hornfreak, he squares off with Legato for a final showdown. Making matters worse, the townsfolk are stuck in the middle of the chaos!

Meryl and Millie are doing their best to get by as Vash recovers, but when the locals discover that the infamous gunslinger is nearby, they set out to make him pay for their recent pains - with his life.
The greatest battle of Vash the Stampede’s life arrives as he faces-off against Millions Knives. One brother wants to destroy mankind. One brother must stop him at any cost.
